purpose: Candidate intake and evidence governance only; not component approval.
rules: Only independently tested candidates may move from researching to smoke_passed.
Only integration evidence may move a candidate to integration_passed.
B0 records do not authorize imports into H:/studybuddy or H:/studybuddy-integration.
Network is disabled by default; live external targets are prohibited in smoke.
Artifacts must be sanitized and must exclude secrets, raw source, absolute private paths, and raw provider/tool errors.
Large binaries, model files, archives, credentials, and generated results remain local and ignored.
